product_overview: ATLS V2 provides a farm structure view for navigating agricultural locations across sectors, stages, and enclosures. It helps users inspect stage-level summaries, enclosure execution records, and sector-level aggregates while respecting feature toggles for intelligence-related content.
core_goals: Navigate the farm hierarchy from sector to stage to enclosure
Review stage-level agricultural statistics and lifecycle milestones
Inspect active child enclosures under a stage
Track daily enclosure execution records and operational logs
View sector-level tree counts and harvested output
Hide intelligence-related content when the feature toggle is disabled

features.name: Farm Structure Hierarchy
features.description: Allows users to move through the agricultural location hierarchy and inspect details at each level.
user_flows: Navigate to /farm -> Select a stage profile -> View stage details and child enclosure breakdown -> Select an enclosure dashboard -> View enclosure execution details
Navigate to /farm -> Select a stage profile -> View the lifecycle milestone timeline -> Review the stage's aggregated statistics
Navigate to /farm -> Select a stage profile -> View the breakdown table of active child enclosures

features.name: Stage Profile Overview
features.description: Shows stage-level summary information including key agricultural totals and milestone history.
user_flows: Navigate to a stage profile -> View tree count, total harvested yield, and last irrigation/fertilization values -> Review the lifecycle milestone timeline
Navigate to a stage profile -> Check the breakdown table of active child enclosures -> Select an enclosure dashboard -> View enclosure details

features.name: Enclosure Execution Records
features.description: Displays daily agricultural execution information and operational logs for an enclosure.
user_flows: Navigate to an enclosure dashboard -> Review daily logs, irrigation records, fertilization records, pest control logs, and warehouse consumption records
Navigate to an enclosure dashboard -> Review equipment logs alongside daily execution records

features.name: Sector Summary Overview
features.description: Shows sector-level aggregate agricultural performance for the selected sector.
user_flows: Navigate to a sector profile -> View overall tree counts and aggregate harvested output

features.name: Feature Toggle Visibility
features.description: Controls whether intelligence-related tabs, widgets, and buttons are shown on farm structure pages.
user_flows: Navigate to /farm -> Turn the intelligence feature off -> Open a stage profile -> Observe that intelligence widgets are hidden
Navigate to /farm -> Turn the intelligence feature off -> Open a sector profile -> Observe that operational intelligence features are hidden
Navigate to /farm -> Turn the intelligence feature off -> Open an enclosure dashboard -> Observe that intelligence-related tabs are hidden

features.name: Farm Structure Hierarchy
features.description: Navigate between Sector, Stage, and Enclosure details page
user_interactions: View breakdown table of child enclosures under Stage
View agriculture lifecycle timeline under Stage

features.name: Feature Toggles
features.description: Conditional visibility of operational intelligence features
user_interactions: Check if Analysis tab and buttons are hidden on Stage, Sector, and Enclosure pages
